name: unifi-mcp-server
description: Secure, read-only remote MCP server for UniFi networks, running on Cloudflare Workers.

UNIFI_API_KEY.description: UniFi API key. Cloud mode: Site Manager key from unifi.ui.com → API. Local mode: UniFi OS key from a View-Only admin.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your GitHub OAuth app (callback URL: https://<your-worker-url>/callback).

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your GitHub OAuth app.

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random secret for signing cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

ALLOWED_GITHUB_USERS.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins allowed to sign in. Empty = nobody (deny by default).

UNIFI_MODE.description: cloud (no tunnel, via unifi.ui.com) or local (Workers VPC + Cloudflare Tunnel).

UNIFI_CONSOLE_ID.description: Cloud mode: console ID from the unifi.ui.com URL. Optional if you own a single console.

MCP_RESOURCE.description: Optional. Public MCP URL; defaults to this Worker's URL + /mcp.
